https://www.furaffinity.net/user/galaxia22/

"Been working on a comic featuring my resident lizard slut, Soursop, getting up to his usual business.

The whole thing's gonna be about 16 pages.

Never tackled an art project of this size before and it'll probably be a while before I attempt another, considering how little free time I can dedicate to drawing these days. I still had a ton of fun with it though, so I hope ya'll enjoy!

We love a happy, horny ending around here folks

I still don't know what possessed me to crank this whole thing out, it's a huge departure from my usual one-and-done pieces. A fun challenge considering I've never really done a comic before, though. If I could go back and do it over again there's some things I'd approach differently, but for the low-stakes smut comic that it is, I'm pretty satisfied.

I'm sure a bit will flip in my brain again in the future and I'll get the inspiration to do another one, whether it features Soursop or some other cast of characters. In the meantime I hope you enjoyed this lil romp for what it was!"
